about: Every saved page under tests/fixtures/, cut down by scripts/reduce-fixture.ts (D-24). savedAt is when the one manual request was made (UTC). `refresh --fixtures` builds the sample data from the entries marked sample; the others are for parser tests only.

fixtures.why: leaveOut (D-131): Lagocine listed every Filmhouse cinema on 11 Nov, but none on 17 Nov, when Filmhouse's 7 showed "Times not available yet". Leaving one out keeps that case in the sample, where Filmhouse's featured films show.
Kept out of the sample until Silverbird's Veezi reader replaces Lagocine for Ikeja (D-76): Veezi writes some titles differently from Lagocine, so running both would list the same showing twice.
